Name: Shoulder Rat
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
This is a rat. He sits on your shoulder as an accessory using Fashion Sense. Just a personal mod that I thought other people might like. He comes in white, brown, albino, and black.

Thank you, Slumberwood, for your rats! I started there before editing them to hell and back, but their rats are the bones, go look at their rats if you want coop rats.
Thank you SO MUCH AlesiaLover62 for fixing whatever was causing odd nose glitches on layering accessories, it was driving me crazy.

Downloads.Description: More rat colors! man, white is hard
